title: Image reference semantics + real VLM summary quality
status_reason: Reference discovery cap removed, pagination/cross-directory discovery implemented, context-bound cache key added, tokenizer-measured context budget added, and a real VLM summary call proven against the live endpoint. Human-gold summary quality evaluation (no unsupported repair conclusions) is NOT_RUN because no human gold answer exists for this run.

environment.notes: Real-VLM tests are gated behind @pytest.mark.integration and skip when the endpoint is unreachable. Unit tests use injected fake VLM/tokenizer.

implemented: openviking/indexing/image_context.py: removed the per-image max_occurrences=16 cap entirely; collect_image_contexts now returns every legal occurrence.
Reference discovery is now paginated: _list_all_entries pages VikingFS with node_limit=LIST_PAGE_SIZE (256) and offset until a short/empty page, so a page boundary never drops entries.
Cross-directory discovery: _discover_markdown_sources recurses into subdirectories (bounded by MAX_DIRECTORY_DEPTH, not by occurrence count) so references in sibling/descendant directories are found.

Tokenizer-measured budget: new load_vlm_token_counter() loads the exact model tokenizer from embedding.chunking.tokenizer_path/tokenizer_sha256 via openviking.indexing.plan.load_tokenizer and returns a counter; truncate_to_token_budget() uses it (falls back to the shared conservative estimator when no tokenizer is configured). No occurrence count is hardcoded.
extract_occurrences() accepts an optional count_tokens and VERSION bumped to image-context-v2 so context hashes change with the new budget semantics.

openviking/indexing/image_cache.py: new occurrence_identity() and cache_key(signature, occurrences) bind the model/prompt semantics_signature to every reference context hash/epoch; store_image_semantics writes cache_key into the payload and load_image_semantics rejects a payload whose cache_key no longer matches the current contexts (context change invalidates the cached summary). Cache VERSION bumped to image-semantics-cache-v2.
Each joint (image+context) embedding input already contains the per-occurrence summary plus the original image (verified by test in this footprint and by test_image_publication.py).

The image_summary.yaml template contract (visible facts vs contextual interpretation, mark uncertainty, figure purpose in chapter) is exercised by the real-VLM integration test which asserts the rendered prompt carries those instructions.

test_commands.result: 29 passed (1 of them the real-VLM integration test against the live endpoint)
1 passed (real qwen3.8-27b vision call returned a nonempty summary from the updated template)

test_commands.note: Failures are in untracked files owned by other agents (test_hybrid_profile.py::test_hybrid_leaf_recall_survives_lexical_failure, test_kb_jobs_http.py::test_queued_position_unknown_progress_and_fifo_order, test_kb_jobs_http.py::test_failed_retry_and_cancelled_are_visible_and_clear). Neither imports image_context/image_cache; outside this footprint.

acceptance_proof.no_cap_17plus_references: test_collector_keeps_more_than_sixteen_references: 25 references collected, all context hashes distinct.
acceptance_proof.cross_directory_pagination: test_collector_paginates_and_discovers_cross_directory_references: a page boundary (offset==LIST_PAGE_SIZE) is exercised and a reference in a sibling directory is discovered via recursion.
acceptance_proof.context_change_invalidates_cache: test_cache_key_includes_context_signature_so_context_change_invalidates (context hash and epoch both change the key) + test_stored_payload_binds_context_signature_and_load_rejects_stale_key (load refuses a stale key).
acceptance_proof.joint_input_has_summary_and_image: test_each_joint_occurrence_input_contains_summary_and_image: each of 2 occurrence messages is ['text','image_url'] with the matching summary.
